description: Machine-readable source of truth for stable GitLab workflow snippet transport contracts. The human-readable Markdown table in gitlab/reference/snippet-transports.md is checked against this metadata.

via_evidence_requirement.summary: Reports that rely on GitLab API transport evidence must state via=mcp for MCP primary transport or via=glab-fallback for guarded fallback/helper transport; via=n/a is reserved for no-action handoffs.

mutation_guard.applies_to: all snippets with non-empty allowed_mutations; read-only snippets feed decision-grade evidence into the guard before later mutations

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `get_project`; local `git` for cwd, remote URL, branch/ref state.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `finish_merge_request` checks native project/MR/SHA/branches and supplied role/authority, performs at most one action, and returns native readback plus optional nullable advisory `ci`.
markdown.inputs: Native: `project`, `merge_request_iid`, `reviewed_sha`, `action`, `source_branch`, actual `target_branch`, `caller_role`, `authority`, `authority_source`; optional `should_remove_source_branch`. Gate/review proof, default branch, issue/worktree are caller inputs only.
markdown.outputs: Native action/readback and advisory CI; caller assembles workflow `finish_result`/handoff with separate issue, branch, cleanup, identity, and `via` evidence.
markdown.required_guards: Caller verifies exact-candidate Gate Receipt, independent review, authority provenance and identity/context; native success is not proof. Builder stops at handoff; fail closed on stale head, missing proof, same-session review/finish, unsupported action, dirty cleanup, or native refusal. Human release is no-mutation handoff.
markdown.fallback_conditions: Raw `glab` fallback only under snippet-specific documented MCP gaps after MCP re-read and all reviewed-SHA, Gate Receipt, authority, caller, and readback guards pass; no helper-script finish path is active workflow and advisory CI status never affects fallback eligibility.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required after any mutation: caller re-reads MR and separately gathers post-merge issue/branch and local-cleanup evidence in policy order; record `via=...`.
